description:
"Wobble meets Wackies for rare Weatherall after hours session. At Plastic People. In Sliders" (Jim Lister - version radio)

Awash with post punk, dub and twisted future funk sensibilities throughout, the Birds Of Paradise EP is full to the brim with heady doses to medicate the soul, and cajole the dance-at-home stragglers out into the night.

Hot on the heels of the ‘Dub Protection & The Sportswear Mystics’ cassette, this EP all but sold-out and follows the dynamite success of the Duo’s debut long player “High Protection & The Sportswear Mystics” and it’s follow-up hype cassette of dubbed out versions.

For customers buying the EP making sure you download both of the bonus tracks that come with the EP bundle :)
